svg.text: Each letter over the logo itself, at the scale the A puts it (7.888 units/pt), placed so the ring’s own centre lands on the letter’s chord
centre — the white dot. That placement is the rule, not a fit: under “the ring exactly” a chord IS the piece of ring its span exposes.
The G is not shown three times.
Its bar spans 157.6, which is under the 251.11 crossover, so every reading gives the same glyph — short chords agree and only long ones
diverge. That is worth stating once rather than printing three identical pictures, which is what this sheet did before.
The mark runs past every letter; only the piece inside is drawn. The G takes the ring reflected in its bar’s height.
